mapper.select: SELECT id,event_id,payload,attempts FROM catalog_event_outbox WHERE status IN ('NEW','RETRY') AND next_attempt_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY id LIMIT #{batchSize}
mapper.update: UPDATE catalog_event_outbox SET status='PUBLISHED',attempts=attempts+1,published_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,last_error=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('NEW','RETRY')

UPDATE catalog_event_outbox SET status=CASE WHEN attempts+1>=#{maxAttempts} THEN 'DEAD' ELSE 'RETRY' END, attempts=attempts+1,next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt},last_error=#{error} WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('NEW','RETRY')
